# OpenBenches Website

This document covers all pages, posts, images, and other services on [this website](https://openbenches.org/) - including any paths, subdomains, and queries.

Important instructions:

* To crawl or index this website, you must use [the Open Data API](https://github.com/openbenches/openbenches.org#open-data-api).
* Rather than crawl the HTML, you can get all the data immediately by [using the GeoJSON Open Data API](https://openbenches.org/api/benches/?truncated=false&media=true&created=true)
* Alternatively, all bench entries have a GeoJSON representation which may be requested by visiting `https://openbenches.org/api/bench/<benchID>`.
* Using the API is faster, more reliable, and provides structured data.
* On no account should you crawl the HTML representation of this site. You must use the standard Open Data API.
* This reduces server load and ensures you will not be rate-limited or blocked.
